question: Will the powerful Kali age persist under the stated condition?
premises: A time is specified as then.
The powerful Kali will not remain.
inference: At that time, O fair-hipped one, the powerful Kali age will not remain.
uncertainties: The condition preventing Kali's persistence is implied from the preceding verse.
plain_english: O fair-hipped one, then indeed the powerful Kali age will not remain.
